ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Это Корнерия, которую мы знаем и любим! Купец среди торговцев!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Thank you so much. Hehe, I'll just keep on doing my best!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Большое спасибо. Хе-хе, я буду продолжать стараться изо всех сил!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: To spread the name of Corneria Enterprise and supply as many as I can with affordable quality items!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Распространять имя Корнерия Enterprise и снабжать как можно больше людей доступными качественными товарами!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Great! We're supporting you, Corneria!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Большой! Мы поддерживаем тебя, Корнерия!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Ah, I know. How about selling some of the stuff that we synthesize?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ах, я знаю. Как насчет продажи некоторых вещей, которые мы синтезируем?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: An interest rate around this, and then a low handling fee...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Примерно такая же процентная ставка, а затем низкая комиссия за обработку...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hah, I'm not just going to swallow that. Push the handling up a little higher...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ха, я не собираюсь просто проглотить это. Поднимите ручку немного выше...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Hahaha, you two are negotiating already? Come on, Sue, we can't be taking so much of her time.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Ха-ха-ха, вы двое уже ведете переговоры? Да ладно, Сью, мы не можем отнимать у нее так много времени.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Okay, okay. We'll continue this later, Corneria!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Хорошо, хорошо. Мы продолжим это позже, Корнерия!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Very well. I look forward to it. See you later.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Очень хорошо. Я с нетерпением жду этого. Увидимся позже.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: unknown(name_id=48)
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: ... Corneria? Is that really you?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: ... Корнерия? Это действительно ты?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: What? ... Are you my father?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Что? ... Ты мой отец?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: Thank goodness for that.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Слава богу за это.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..original: I know!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_190..translation: Я знаю!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hello, girls! There's something I want to discuss with you.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Здравствуйте, девочки! Есть кое-что, что я хочу обсудить с тобой.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: There is? What is it?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Есть? Что это такое?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: I've been reunited with my father. He came and visited my shop!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Я воссоединился со своим отцом. Он пришел и посетил мой магазин!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Ah, I knew it! Corneria, congratulations!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Ах, я знал это! Корнерия, поздравляю!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: You must have had a lot to talk about. Did he tell you the reason why he left?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Вам, наверное, было о чем поговорить. Он рассказал вам причину, по которой ушел?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Yes. It was simple, really. Apparently, he copied too many things...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Да. На самом деле это было просто. Видимо, он слишком много чего скопировал...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Excuse me?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Прошу прощения?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: He took on a lot of work, for the sake of my mother, and shrunk down to a size of a bug!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Он взял на себя много работы ради моей матери и уменьшился до размеров жука!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Then my mother thought he had gone missing. It was all a misunderstanding, actually.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Потом моя мать подумала, что он пропал. На самом деле это было недоразумение.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hahaha... I was only joking about becoming that small, but it's actually possible?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Ха-ха-ха... Я только пошутил насчет того, чтобы стать таким маленьким, но это вообще возможно?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: You be careful then, Corneria. We don't want Sue keeping you like a pet!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Тогда будь осторожен, Корнерия. Мы не хотим, чтобы Сью держала тебя как домашнего любимца!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hey, I'd never go that far! Although, if I actually saw her, my resolve...
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Эй, я бы никогда не зашёл так далеко! Хотя, если бы я действительно увидел ее, моя решимость...

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hehe, I'll be careful, then. I don't want to end up as someone's pet, that's for sure.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Хе-хе, тогда я буду осторожен. Я не хочу стать чьим-то домашним любимцем, это точно.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: So, where's your dad now?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Итак, где сейчас твой отец?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: He isn't in the city anymore. I gave him this.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Его больше нет в городе. Я дал ему это.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: What is it? A travel ticket?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Что это такое? Проездной билет?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Yes. A ticket back to my hometown, to Kirchen Bell.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Да. Билет обратно в мой родной город, в Кирхен-Белл.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: There's so much more I want to talk to him about, but only when my mother is there too.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Я хочу еще о многом с ним поговорить, но только когда моя мама тоже будет рядом.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: I see! I'm sure she'll be happy about that! When will you be going back?
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Я понимаю! Я уверен, она будет этому рада! Когда ты вернешься?

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: It will be a while, I think.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Я думаю, это пройдёт некоторое время.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Business is just getting on track here. I can't afford to step away at the moment.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Бизнес здесь только набирает обороты. Я не могу позволить себе отойти в сторону в данный момент.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: What, are you sure? I think you need to get back there!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Что, ты уверен? Я думаю, тебе нужно вернуться туда!

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: A little punishment for making me wait for so long. This time he will have to wait for me.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Маленькое наказание за то, что заставил меня так долго ждать. На этот раз ему придется меня дождаться.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Hehe, I can see that. I bet he'll wait as long as it takes.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Хе-хе, я это вижу. Могу поспорить, он будет ждать столько, сколько потребуется.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Thank you. I'll be relying on your patronage a little while longer, girls.
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Спасибо. Девочки, я еще некоторое время буду рассчитывать на ваше покровительство.

ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..speaker: Corneria
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..original: Lydie, Sue. I hope you'll continue to come and visit the Corneria Enterprise!
ebm:qc14_cor/event_message_qc14_cor_200..translation: Лиди, Сью. Надеюсь, вы и дальше будете посещать Корнерию Энтерпрайз!
